records.name: Maspalomas gay beach — Kiosk 7

records.description: The Gay Passport's 2026 Gran Canaria guide identifies the gay beach historically known as Kiosk 7. These conflicting labels do not undermine the established beach-area identity, but make a precisely numbered kiosk pin unreliable. 2026 first-person TripAdvisor reviews document actual naturist/gay-friendly beach visits, not necessarily cruising encounters. Do not conflate open public beach with protected dune areas and bushes.
